title: Claudin1 IHC Morphology of Human Vagus Nerve
author: Nicole A. Pelot
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6fzhbp6
materials: We used Nikon's NIS Elements software (v5.02.01, Build 1270) to segment human vagus nerve immunohistochemical micrographs (anti-claudin-1) using the General Analysis RGB tool.
Dehydrate, clear, and coverslip using DPX mountant.
We used Nikon's NIS Elements software (v5.02.01, Build 1270) to segment human vagus nerve immunohistochemical micrographs (anti-claudin-1) using the General Analysis RGB tool.

steps.title: Prepare Paraffin-Embedded Slides
steps.instruction: Bake slides containing sections of paraffin-embedded vagus nerve overnight at 60°C, then cool overnight.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize the slides and hydrate them to distilled water using the following sequence:

substeps.instruction: Xylene (2x 6 min)
100% ethanol (5 min)
95% ethanol (4 min)
70% ethanol (3 min)
Deionized water (2x 1 min)

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Epitope Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Perform HIER using a buffer with pH 6.0 (Thermo, TA-135-HBL) and cool the samples.

substeps.instruction: Heat at 120°C for 30 s
Heat at 90°C for 10 s
Cool for 20 min at room temperature
Rinse in deionized water (2x 2 min)

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase and Proteins
steps.instruction: Block the samples to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Block with 3% H2O2 diluted in deionized water for 10 min
Rinse in deionized water (2x 2 min)
Rinse in Tris buffer (1x 2 min)
Block using DAKO Protein Block (X0909) for 10 min at room temperature

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with the primary antibody and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Apply rabbit anti-claudin-1 (Abcam, ab15098) diluted in Thermo Antibody Diluent at 1:50
Incubate overnight at 4°C
Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)
Rinse in Tris buffer (1x 2 min)

steps.title: Apply Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with the secondary antibody and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Apply biotinylated SP-conjugated Affinipure goat anti-rabbit IgG (H+L) (Jackson, 111-065-144) diluted in Thermo Antibody Diluent at 1:500
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature
Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)
Rinse in Tris buffer (1x 2 min)

steps.title: Apply ABC Elite Complex
steps.instruction: Apply the ABC Elite complex and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Apply ABC Elite (Vector, PK-6100) at 1:50 for 30 min at room temperature
Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)
Rinse in Tris buffer (1x 2 min)

steps.title: Develop with DAB Chromogen
steps.instruction: Apply DAB chromogen to visualize the staining and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Apply DAB chromogen (Thermo, TA-125-QHDX) for 1 min at room temperature
Rinse in deionized water (2x 2 min)

steps.title: Image Samples
steps.instruction: Capture images of the stained sections.

substeps.instruction: Image each sample at 10x using a Nikon Ti2 microscope with a Photometrics Prime 95B-25MM camera (Nikon Instruments Inc.)
Select the best of four slices per sample based on quality (no tearing or fraying)

steps.title: Process Images and Generate Masks
steps.instruction: Convert segmented images into masks and extract coordinates using Matlab.

substeps.instruction: Convert binary segmented images into 'Graticule Masks' (binary images saved as TIFs)
Import TIFs into Matlab and use the bwboundaries function to generate a data structure of x and y coordinates for each closed boundary
Scale pixel coordinates to microns using the segmented scale bar

steps.title: Refine Image Analysis
steps.instruction: Apply preprocessing, selection, and postprocessing to identify nerve structures.

substeps.instruction: Select preprocessing steps (e.g., smoothing and sharpening)
Select ranges of hues, saturations, and intensities to identify the perineurium and the entirety of the nerve
Select postprocessing steps (e.g., minimum size criterion to eliminate off-target regions, smoothing, cleaning, closing, and filling holes)
Perform manual adjustments, including deletion of off-target regions and filling of missed target areas

steps.title: Calculate Morphological Metrics
steps.instruction: Quantify the cross-sectional area and diameter of the nerve and fascicles.

substeps.instruction: Store pixel coordinates with indexing to assign a fascicle number, ensuring interior and exterior perineurium traces relate to the same fascicle
Calculate cross-sectional area of each fascicle (inner and outer perineurium traces) and nerve using Matlab’s polyarea
Determine effective diameter (diameter of a circle with the same cross-sectional area as the raw trace)
Calculate perineurium thickness as half of the difference in effective diameters of the inner and outer perineurium traces
